actions.name: search
actions.summary: Searches aggregated news from the user's subscribed sources (RSS / RSSHub / optional News API). Omit "query" to get the latest headlines. Filter by "topic". Set "cluster"=true to group multiple reports about the same event. Each result includes the article URL — pass it to the read action to fetch full text. News may be delayed; for reference only.

Omit for latest headlines."},"topic":{"type":"string","enum":["top","world","china","tech","business","science","culture","sports","health"],"description":"Optional topic filter."},"cluster":{"type":"boolean","description":"Group same-event reports into clusters. Default false."},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":30,"description":"Max results (1-30). Default 15."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: read
actions.summary: Fetches the readable full text of one news article for analysis or summarization. Pass the article "url" (from a search result) or its "id". Returns cleaned article text (truncated to 6000 characters) plus metadata. If the site blocks extraction or is outside this applet's network allowlist, returns the available summary — suggest opening the original.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string","description":"The article URL (from a search result)."},"id":{"type":"string","description":"The article stable id (alternative to url)."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: source
actions.summary: Manages the user's news subscriptions. "action": "list" = show sources; "add" = subscribe (set "url" to an RSS/Atom URL, or an RSSHub route starting with "/" like "/zhihu/hotlist"; optional "title"/"topic"/"kind"); "remove" = unsubscribe (match by "title" or "url"); "test" = fetch a URL/route once and report how many articles came back. RSSHub routes need an instance configured in settings. Hosts outside this applet's network allowlist cannot be fetched.

Required for add/test; add or remove key."},"title":{"type":"string","description":"Display name (add), or match key (remove)."},"topic":{"type":"string","enum":["top","world","china","tech","business","science","culture","sports","health"],"description":"Topic for add."},"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["rss","atom","rsshub","api"],"description":"Source kind for add (inferred if omitted)."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: save
actions.summary: Saves or removes articles in the user's read-later list. "action": "save" (set "url" or "id" from a search result), "unsave" (by "id" or "url"), or "list" to show saved articles.

actions.name: toggleBroadcast
actions.summary: Start or stop reading the current news list aloud. Drives the in-app broadcast bar; needs the visible list, so it is a UI action rather than an agent tool.
